DT.Categories.AbilityScoreProminence.Hin: Display tweaks for ability scores on dnd5e actor sheets. Per-user.
DT.Settings.AbilitySwapScoreAndMod.Name: Show Ability Score Large
DT.Settings.AbilitySwapScoreAndMod.Hint: Makes the score the large, prominent number and the modifier small. On the default dnd5e sheet the score also moves directly under the ability name. Also applies to the Tidy 5e Character Sheet (non-classic).
DT.Settings.AbilityExpandedRollTargets.H: Lets you click the ability score or modifier (not just the ability name) to roll an ability check.
DT.Notifications.NoRollMethod: Darkviruzz Tweaks: no ability-roll method found for {ability}.
